class.name: HEGoGeoPrimSelection
class.brief_description: A set of primitives of a [HEGoGeoSurfaces].

method.name: size
method.description: How many primitives this selection holds.

method.name: get_indices
method.description: The primitive indices, for callers that want to index into [method HEGoGeoSurfaces.get_attribute] themselves.

method.name: filter_by
method.description: The subset whose [code]name[/code] attribute equals [code]value[/code]. Returns an empty selection, with a warning, when the attribute is missing or was never loaded.

method.name: split_by
method.description:
This selection grouped by the value of [code]name[/code], as [code]{ value: HEGoGeoPrimSelection }[/code].
Primitives the attribute is not set on land under a [code]null[/code] key, and an attribute the HDA does not have at all yields a single [code]null[/code] group holding everything, so a handler can fall back to a default name rather than losing the geometry.

method.name: get_surface
method.description:
Builds the Godot surface for these primitives, as [code]{ "surface_array": [...], <requested attributes>: [...] }[/code].
[code]surface_array[/code] goes straight into [method ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays]. It holds only the points these primitives use, compacted, with the indices remapped to match.
The requested primitive attributes come back as one value per primitive in this selection, in the same order as [method get_indices]. Attributes the HDA does not have are left out, so read them with [code]Dictionary.get()[/code] rather than assuming the key exists.
